findings.old_behavior: The get_job_options() function validates the "term_finish" option of term_start(). Previously, only "open" and "close" were accepted as valid values. Passing "noclose" would cause an E475 error: "Invalid value for argument "term_finish": noclose".
findings.new_behavior: The validation is relaxed to also accept "noclose" as a valid value for "term_finish". When set, the terminal window will not close (and no window will be opened) when the job finishes. The buffer remains hidden, listed, and loaded with terminal output available.
findings.compatibility_reason: This is an additive (relaxed) input contract change. The set of accepted values for the "term_finish" option of term_start() is expanded from {"open", "close"} to {"open", "close", "noclose"}. No existing callers are broken since previously "noclose" would simply error. However, Vimscript code that string-checks valid term_finish values may need updating if it validates against a hard-coded list.

evidence.snippet:
"term_finish"	What to do when the job is finished:
			"close": close any windows
			"noclose": window will not be opened
			"open": open window if needed

findings.why_not_internal_only: term_start() is part of the public Vimscript API. The "term_finish" option is documented in runtime/doc/terminal.txt and exposed to all Vimscript callers. Both the options and vimscript API surfaces classify this as public.
findings.uncertainty: No uncertainty: the change is straightforward. The only question is whether plugin code that manually validates term_finish values needs updating.
findings.recommended_review: Review any Vimscript plugins that validate "term_finish" values with hard-coded lists (e.g., checking only "open" and "close"). The official documentation already reflects the new value.
findings.test_recommendation: Run existing terminal finish tests (open/close) to verify no regression. Run the new "noclose" test which verifies that a terminal with term_finish=noclose keeps the buffer hidden, listed, and loaded after job completion.
